# Winter rides need an exit option

Joined the shorter club ride after checking where I could turn for home. Having an exit made it easier to begin. The group leader treated leaving early as sensible rather than disappointing. [[Routes]]: a route description could include ways to shorten the journey after departure. Commitment does not have to mean losing every later choice.
